articleBody:
After a good Texas rain in Addison, you might wonder if your roof held up okay. Sometimes rain damage isn't immediately obvious, but catching it early can save you a lot of headache and money. This checklist will help you identify potential issues from the ground so you know when it's time to call in the pros for a closer look. Remember, safety first – never get on a wet or visibly damaged roof yourself!

- [ ] Look for missing or displaced shingles — why this matters: Strong winds during heavy rain can lift or tear off shingles, leaving your roof decking exposed to water.
- [ ] Check for granules in your gutters or downspouts — why this matters: Excessive shingle granules can indicate your roof is aging or has suffered impact damage, like from hail accompanying rain.
- [ ] Examine flashing around chimneys, vents, and skylights — why this matters: Flashing seals these vulnerable areas; if it's bent, cracked, or loose, water can easily seep underneath.
- [ ] Look for water stains or discoloration on exterior walls — why this matters: This can be a sign that your gutters aren't diverting water correctly, or that water is overflowing and running down your siding.
- [ ] Inspect your gutters for clogs or disconnections — why this matters: Clogged or damaged gutters can cause water to back up and pool on your roof or spill over, leading to fascia and foundation damage.
- [ ] Check interior ceilings and walls for new water spots or dampness — why this matters: This is the most direct sign of a roof leak, indicating water has penetrated your attic and possibly your living space.
- [ ] Pay attention to any musty odors in your attic or upper floors — why this matters: Persistent dampness or mold growth from a leak can cause distinct smells, even if you don't see visible water.

How to use this checklist: Go through these items from the safety of the ground, ideally with binoculars for a closer look at the roof. If you spot any of these signs, it's a good idea to reach out to a professional. Discounted Roofing Co. can provide an honest assessment, taking dated photographs and preparing a detailed report of any findings. This helps identify issues before they become major problems, providing peace of mind.
